blocks.text: Translating to Arabic is more difficult than translating from Arabic: the Italian "tire" the Arabic phrase towards its structures, and the result is an Arabic understandable but full of casts: the article in the wrong place, the Italian preposition translated to the letter, the order of the Italian words, the wrong agreements with the plural of things. At level B2 The goal is realistic: to translate simple and short texts (warnings, formal messages, short news) into a correct and clear Arabic, using as a model the Arabic texts you know. In this unit learn the basic rules of translation to Arabic (G73), the prepositions that change from one language to another, the most frequent casts and the method of parallel texts. Four weeks, in parallel with the end of EGY-17 and the beginning of EGY-18.
